prompt: You can repair your old washing machine for $200; it then costs $80 a year to run. A new machine costs $600 and costs $40 a year to run. Comparing the repair with buying new over 3 years, how much less does the repair path cost in total?
explanation: Repair path: $200 + (3 x $80 = $240) = $440. New machine: $600 + (3 x $40 = $120) = $720. Difference: $720 - $440 = $280, so repairing costs less over the 3 years. The $400 option compares only the upfront prices ($600 - $200) and ignores the running costs.
